title: He Drifted 438 Days Across the Pacific

segments.text: This man drifted {438|four hundred thirty-eight} days across the Pacific. And he lived.
November {2012|twenty twelve}. José heads out to fish off Mexico. A {30-hour|thirty-hour} trip.
Day two. A storm kills the engine. The current drags them out to sea.
They eat raw fish. Turtles. Seabirds. They drink the rain.
{Month 4.|Month four.} His crewmate, Ezequiel, stops eating. Now José is alone.
Ships pass by. None of them stop. He counts the days by the moon.
Day {438|four hundred thirty-eight}. Birds. Coconuts. Land. {6,700|Six thousand seven hundred} miles from home.
